repeat.selection: default_rng(repeat_selection).permutation(512)[:128], original prepared DEV identity order, no outcome or REAL values
repeat.normalized_waveform: waveform256 / observed_Q only when Q > frozen TRAIN q_floor; retain all other raw rows and explicit defined counts
repeat.scalar_covariance_missing_rule: pairwise jointly defined draws, save the count for every covariance entry; Q/PSD use all64 finite guarded-PSD draws
repeat.raw_PSD_undefined: NaN for exactly zero Q; preserve row and definition counts

shape_intervention.selection: first32 parents in frozen repeat selection order
shape_intervention.donor: among all other DEV SOURCE parents minimize abs(log(Qj/Qi)); tie by ascending original identity; no outcome or REAL selection
shape_intervention.scale: centered donor384 * Qi/Qj, no clipping; original centered carrier384 retained
shape_intervention.paired_latents: one saved32x8 explicit intervention bank, reused across variants, nodes, arms and hypotheses
shape_intervention.paired_statistics: per-draw delta, mean delta, sample std and MonteCarlo SE=sample_std/sqrt(jointly_defined_draws), explicit counts

Q_trend.source_shape: same32 original centered shapes as shape_intervention
Q_trend.scale: centered carrier384 * frozen_Qnode/Qi, no input clipping
Q_trend.node_selection: read frozen TRAIN preparation edges; no DEV fitting
Q_trend.paired_latents: exact same saved intervention bank as shape_intervention
Q_trend.qbar_monotonicity: report signed adjacent qbar differences and flags separately from noisy observed Q; no scientific threshold

population.coordinate: z=(2*b-7)/7, b=fixed SOURCE TRAIN Q8 bin0..7
population.normalization: parent weights sum to number of parents; each parent's four draws has equal weight; all parents retained
population.waveform_global_moments: exact mixture of main four-draw fixed-SOURCE-bin mean/std(ddof0)/rows, because each parent in a SOURCE bin has the same weight
population.waveform_SOURCE_conditional_moments: unchanged within SOURCE bin; save weighted masses and support
population.waveform_output_Q_conditional_moments: not available from marginal main curve statistics; no extra forward, no approximation
population.h_physical_meaning: unknown; h metadata is not used for weights or particle-composition claims

time_morphology.crossings: nearest outward crossing from selected peak16; linear interpolation; report undefined if peak<=0 or crossing absent
time_morphology.missing_values: NaN in NPZ, null plus definition counts in JSON; never remove parent rows

baseline_statistics.input: original100 uncentered ADC baseline; shared exactly across arms and hypotheses
baseline_statistics.power_fraction_denominator: max(sum(abs(rfft(centered))^2 over bins1..50),1e-30), inherited005 validation definition
baseline_statistics.S: exp(frozen005 eta * explicit baseline_scale latent - eta^2); prefix/S/extension epsilon shared across hypotheses

identity_order_replay.base: shape_intervention original32x8 rows, exact saved intervention bank

claim_boundaries: Conditional sample covariance is a model statistic under these latent/electronics hypotheses, not uniquely identified physical response truth.
Shape replacement may have near-zero actual intervention strength; never choose another donor after observing the difference.
Q-node trends are input interventions, not an energy calibration or physical nonlinearity measurement.
Positive SOURCE-Q tilts are internal population sensitivity, not particle-composition or independent-acquisition transfer evidence.
The electronics hypotheses are sensitivity assumptions, not a confidence set or hardware identification.
No classifier is trained: independent C2ST remains unexecuted in this addon.
All originally selected parent/draw rows and undefined flags remain in artifacts.
